svg.text: Katran — page 2: modules and modulation cables (S103 P5 tree)

Cores collapsed to their essential modules. Internal modulators are their own modules; each has one coloured bus, dropped onto labelled input jacks (○). Platform LFO / velocity not shown. Amounts: the cable list (right).
window; position = the osc's pos, speed =
its pitch; DC block → dmp LP → guard 0.7
one value per sample (core B: per half-rate)
form: typ / wav / pos (shared) — or buffer
hard sync in: Osc 2 wrap + own core's D > snc
form: shared typ / wav, own pos(2)
D → own Osc 1 copy's sync (snc); D → other core (xfb)
D → own Osc 1 copy's sync (snc); D → other core (xfb)
chaos → LFO rate jitter, CE1 / CE2 cycle + peak, rotation rate
the trigger also sets the note (OSC pitch)
Cable list — internal modulation (amount = the code's law)
* dpt (lfl) is applied twice on these five: cv = shape × lfl, then × lfl again (depth ∝ lfl²).
System modulation not drawn: the platform LFO (lfo_*, 2 destinations, any row) and
velocity (dst / amt, one row; velocity also sets kE).
Direct audio coupling: only xfb (each core's D into the other's loop write), and only when
spr < 63 (0.6 at spr 0). At spr ≥ 63 — init.kat is 63 — the cores do not exchange audio.
Shared: Osc 2 (one ring modulator for both), every internal modulator, and the loop-level
follower (averages both cores; drives the LFO rate and the CE rise): indirect, control-rate.
Osc 1a / 1b: one oscillator's two copies (core A / core B), detuned by dtn; each is synced
only by its own core. Code names: OSC A = Osc 1, OSC B = Osc 2 (KatranOsc.c, KatranVoice.c).
